notes.title: New Stars DevLog #4 - Species Avatars, Terraformation, Multi-Select, and more...
notes.content:
Another update is being worked on before closed-beta - Infinity. As part of the update, lots of features have been added and improved. There is lots of progress in features being made before closed-beta. Now there is only a number of features left to add, most of which development has already begun on them.

Species Avatars
Species avatars are one of the main features of the Infinity update and give empire diplomacy more depth, and uniqueness. A typewriter effect has also been added to the empire chat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/227f90b01cab7b5efd113cd292b7ca93fd57532d.gif

Species avatars have also been added to game events...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/bed9a87406543c0a5fbc7ff132e38beb783be33c.gif

Main Menu Rework
The main menu has been reworked to make starting games quick and concise. I have also added the ability to customize your species avatar, which is coloured after your primary empire colour.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/c8d4b236dded29150493bfd67290fd99ee8ba8d6.gif

Terraform Planets
Terraformation was added last month, but is now fully tested. UI has been added to track progress of terraformation. You can transform barren planets into worlds, if there is not already a world in the star system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/899f9f0da7903c568ff7f765453dfca66fcc31fb.gif

Terraformation requires the Terraformation technology, and is an expensive action. It is a mid-game action that gives your empire the ability to further expand within.

Select and Manage Multiple Fleets
No more having to select each individual fleet! You can also use a drag box to select fleets, and order them in a group. This required a complete rework of the old interaction manager system which was one of the first systems added to New Stars. This also works in the galaxy map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/ad3c7c98b619e7631f88833e15fd16e19e3868b1.gif

That's not it...
There is still an upcoming Part 3 to the Ubiquity update, among other updates, although it will be the most expensive update so far and will have a unique update name. Development has already begun on that update.

Interactive Hyperlane HUDs
Hyperlane HUDs have been added to help fleets navigate across systems. You can now send fleets everywhere in star systems, as intra-system movement has been fully implemented. Hyperlanes act as entries and exits to star systems, and movement between points within a star system is automatically routed and calculated when ordering a fleet to move.

notes.title: New Stars DevLog #2 - Simulated Fleets, Starbases, Structures, and more.
notes.content:
For the past two weeks, I have been busy with development on New Stars. This devlog is overdue, and there have been quite a few developments. Here are are a list of developments made on Ubiquity - the 3D star system simulation.

youtu.be/KyDc__u8hF0

Ubiquity Fleet Movement
There is now system-level fleet movement in New Stars. This means that you can order fleets to move anywhere within a star system. This may have strategic value in the future for combat engagements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/0e3d5e5e66ce3aa355ce90e529e47c228a10ba55.png

Star System Structures
There are 5 structures in New Stars: star-bases, star-docks, star-hubs, star-forts, and jumpgates. Jumpgates could be called 'star-gates' to match the theme. Tell me what you think in the comment section below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/83b5254ac4d83799c7ffe60ee909cdb242abccc9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/17dfc2a4e9884434e9a94fe83ef479ca03baf158.png

Each structure gives its own unique benefit to the owned star system:

 Star-bases are a claim on a star system.
 Star-docks grant the ability to build ships.
 Star-hubs collect resources from adjacent systems.
 Star-forts give the defender a combat advantage within a system.
 Star-gates/Jumpgates allow you to skip hyperlane/star-lane travel between systems.

As of writing this I'm considering using the 'star' prefix where possible, for star system structures.

Ubiquity Nebulae
Star systems have environment nebulae that allows fleets to hide in. They serve a similar purpose as solar storms. Environment nebulae could allow for extra resources in the future, although currently it only effects has visibility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/7071753c2aa3c930b205f8f7846c7ab2e91bb5e1.png

Solar Storms
Solar storms are animated nebulae within a system that block fleet visibility. This could allow for many interesting combat surprises and encounters. Currently, they can be spawned with supernovas or hypernovas. They generally last around 5 in-game years.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/c01e2d9730f69e0e4ccf66cf71dd65a06bfaeaa6.gif

notes.title: New Stars DevLog #1 - January
notes.content:
After hundreds hours of development working on many new features, this month has been the busiest and most expensive month of development. Here is a list of some features we have been working on in January.

1) Ubiquity (Part One)

Ubiquity adds new level of depth for New Stars, and will be the foundation for future updates. This is only part one of the 'Ubiquity' update, due to the scale of the content being added. Ubiquity also includes dynamic orbits, moons, binary star systems, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/52faf9510bbde55c24b3278698dc69979fb3f4a1.png

This is just the beginning of 3D simulation in New Stars. We have lots of exciting things planned with 'Ubiquity'. Stay tuned for more updates on New Stars, or join our community Discord!

Note that after the screenshots were taken, moons now have a letter suffix, and planets that orbit a star have the full star name as a prefix.

2) Colony Events

We are also working on natural disaster events! There's nothing wrong with a bit of chaos every now and then. In some events, the player will have a choice to act to lead to different outcomes. Some choices have different costs, or none at all.

Everything going too well for one of your colonies? Not when there is climate change. Climate change can change a planet to an ice world.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/09fd328d6d83113efd73b7f6073e6135bed104c5.png

Think your colonies are safe from damage while not in a war? Think again. There are multiple outcomes to these events, and the best outcome may require the highest cost, although it there is a chance things won't end up going well...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/c2e63169dba698b955d81b038b21961bc30def85.png

Note that these features were added before Ubiquity, and the old toon-style planets may be replaced with new assets in the coming weeks. They will be missed. Click 'Rate Up' below to pay respects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/75da8dd3b00bbce1f126760745801e4af867d584.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/8b1fc1ace35dc900a611ae64eb109f3be9ed1f21.png

3) Space-based Natural Disasters

New Stars now has natural disasters. They may not be disasters after all as they can unlock new resources.

Solar storms can block sight of fleets within systems, which can be useful for staying hidden.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/be805dcce42ce83758dea3377a0f521c781acbef.png

Other disasters can create white dwarf stars, which are very valuable, or create black holes, which may not always be beneficial. Note that white dwarfs have been in the game since October.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/c21f951983e91eb1c1e1aba5c2e7e3669cccef79.png

4) Special Resources

Owning any surplus of a special resource will grant empire-wide bonuses. These are essential for getting an edge over other empires.

Antimatter - void matter; found in void worlds, and black holes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/ab069805eede19ce621a86620e611d519c459797.png

Pink Plasma - found on pristine worlds, or rare Class-O stars.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/09bb654520a3bb986efee9a7eb62f5c09ab91230.png

Crimson Stardust - found in ancient ruins, broken worlds, and other secret locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/d1140d0edd33a13e63f6d48c1bdfbad860882b69.png

Golden Spice - precious stuff that grows in small quantities on Arid worlds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/512799233386e462722162f18b039270ade44147.png

5) Wormholes

Wormholes act as two-way portals from one system to another. They can enable access to otherwise closed-off regions of the galaxy. Be careful to with star systems with wormholes, as they can make it easier to gain entry to other regions, for better or worse.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/d1bfe063bc39f1bb1e5e540cb1e066539632f2b1.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/3a7408119cc14aef435455c3a1d09cade6890057.png

6) Whiteholes

Whiteholes are the opposite of black holes. Just because we haven't discovered one yet in reality, it doesn't mean that it can't be added to New Stars, where the game starts in the year 2100.

In the context of New Stars, white holes are one-way wormholes. Once you enter them, you cannot go back the way you came. This gives a great advantage to an empire that controls the whitehole entry system, but a disadvantage to whoever controls the whitehole exit system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/88a8ad2ea4bb4a11493e14c44b87a784cd6e0e14.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/476b627e86489795ae4285cbcc15dab8cf8f3220.png

7) Void Worlds

Black holes are probably not good for supporting life, or are they? Void worlds are dark worlds that orbit black holes and are less suitable than regular worlds, but can still be colonized.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/ab069805eede19ce621a86620e611d519c459797.png

8) Graphics - URP Upgrade

Also, we have moved to Unity URP, which resulted in a complete graphics rework. This move means that some old particles and materials have to be completely reworked, for benefit of better graphics. This increases the general quality of planets and stars in-game, which is why we have done this in conjunction with Ubiquity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/a59062e463a9a57d3c7a8b351a931cbc6a6182cf.png

The graphics will require further optimization however, so that 'New Stars' doesn't become 'New GPU'. Thankfully there are graphics settings to optimize performance on less powerful systems.

9) Multiplayer Support

At the start of the year, we announced Steam multiplayer support. This means that the regular game will be able to played in multiplayer, with your Steam friends. The first multiplayer lobby was added in July 2022.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/e085aaeb0cd88d388d84041976abf076beb0d3d2.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/a1fc08fd61b0a872293cbe1700ce256607d5b5ad.png

10) Rename Colonies, Fleets, Ships, and more...

Ships, colonies, empires, and fleets can be renamed. Click the name text, then choose your name.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43312936/cdb533237e5776ae841c081c31724c9e2cd86f42.png

But that's not all...

January was the most productive month for New Stars, and established a new foundation for depth in New Stars. We have been working on other exciting features as well, that are not listed above. We will focus on improving and expanding these features in the coming months. After all, why add lots of features if you're not going to make them good?
